deliverables.change: Built-in provider registry (Indian Kanoon, SC judgments, HC judgments; SCC Online and Manupatra only when a workspace template is configured): key, label, https URL template with {q} placeholder, allowed host. Export `validateProviderTemplate` (https only, no userinfo, host must equal template host, rejects javascript:/data: and other schemes).

Pure `buildResearchLinks(facts, providers)` returning ResearchLink[] {providerKey,label,url,host,target:'_blank',rel:'noopener noreferrer'}; facts are {statute, section, keywords[], court}; encodeURIComponent on every part (Tamil/Kannada); no matter id, CNR or party names; drops any link whose host is not in the allow-list.

CRUD for research notes (list/create/update/delete, authority add/remove/pin flag) modelled on asMatterMember in alerts.ts: NOT_FOUND for unreadable matters, requires memory.read/memory.write so clerk is denied, writes inside the actor workspace scope; plus `getResearchFacts` returning issue keywords only when the actor has strategy.read and only from confirmed tags; and workspace provider template list/save requiring workspace.manage.
Export the new services, `buildResearchLinks`, providers and types.

Tenant tables `research_note` (id, workspace_id, matter_id, title, body, authorities jsonb, created_by, updated_at, composite FK to matter, RLS via tenantTable) and `research_provider` (workspace_id, key, label, url_template, enabled); register in schema/index.ts.

Generate with drizzle-kit (plus meta/20261025050000_snapshot.json and _journal.json entry): both tables, FKs, checks (url_template starts with https://), FORCE RLS policies written like 20261025030000_whatsapp_link.sql. Use the next free number if the lane moved.
zod schemas for note input, authority {label, citation?, url? (https only), pinned}, provider template input; export from packages/validators/src/index.ts.
Add link-out menu (facts from getResearchFacts), the notes list and editor; permission-denied state for notes when the role lacks memory.read; no AI import on the route.
Add note create/update/delete and authority actions via workspaceAction (memory.write); keep existing tag actions unchanged.

Keyboard-operable DropdownMenu (bottom Sheet at 360) of quiet text links, each showing the exact URL preview and 'Opens in a new window on a site we do not control.'; anchors use target=_blank rel='noopener noreferrer'; no iframe. Add notes-list.tsx, note-editor.tsx and *.stories.tsx for each (all states, Tamil and Kannada samples); notes UI read-only while offline via useOfflineSince from components/matters/matters-offline-banner.tsx.

Settings page (advocate+) listing built-in providers and workspace templates; add settings/research/actions.ts (save/remove provider template via workspaceAction, workspace.manage) and an entry in apps/web/lib/settings-nav.ts.

New namespace `research` with en, plus kn/ta stubs (messages/kn/research.json, messages/ta/research.json); add to NAMESPACES in packages/i18n/src/catalog.ts and the top-level key list in packages/i18n/src/__tests__/catalog.test.ts; regenerate with `pnpm --filter @causedeck/i18n i18n:types` (generated/**).

Register the new core runtime exports in SERVICE_TESTS (note CRUD and provider templates, with real cases in packages/core/src/__tests__/cross-tenant/services.test.ts: B on A denied or empty, A unchanged) and the pure exports (buildResearchLinks, providers, validateProviderTemplate) in NOT_A_SERVICE with a reason. Also update packages/db/src/index.test.ts (root table list), packages/db/src/__tests__/rls/sql.test.ts (RLS catalog), packages/db/src/testing/two-tenants.ts (seeders), apps/web/__tests__/cross-tenant-actions.test.ts (ACTIONS and probe inputs for the new note and provider actions), docs/engineering/core-domains.md (research row).

Unit tests: encoding incl. Tamil and Kannada, https-only, host allow-list, rel/target, clerk gets no keywords, unsafe template schemes rejected (also providers.test.ts); apps/web test asserting no iframe in components/research and no @causedeck/ai import in the research route.
Playwright journeys (CI only): link-out menu keyboard, clerk permission-denied, empty/error/offline states, axe, 360/768/1280 light and dark baselines.

preserve.what: Existing tag actions and exports in apps/web/app/(app)/w/[slug]/matters/[id]/research/actions.ts and packages/core/src/research/index.ts (addTag, confirmTag, dismissTag, listTags, proposeTags, scanJudgments, listRelevantJudgments) keep their signatures and behaviour.
Research tab registration in apps/web/lib/matters/tabs.ts (id research, order 40, matter.read) and apps/web/__tests__/matter-tab-registry.test.ts stay valid.

decisions.choice: Gate research notes on memory.read/memory.write (junior and up) rather than matter.read, and issue keywords on strategy.read.
decisions.justification: Issue says notes are memory-adjacent and clerk is denied; packages/auth/src/policy/matrix.ts:19-24 puts memory.* and strategy.read at junior, clerk below.

decisions.choice: Store per-workspace provider templates in a new tenant table `research_provider` instead of a workspace_settings column.
decisions.justification: workspace_settings is a non-tenant table (packages/db/src/schema/workspace.ts:22); tenantTable() gives FORCE RLS like matter_issue_tag (matter-issue.ts:33).

decisions.choice: Reuse the existing Research tab and page for link-outs and notes; no new route or tab.
decisions.justification: Tab already registered at apps/web/lib/matters/tabs.ts:34 and the page at research/page.tsx:25.

decisions.choice: Copy the asMatterMember access pattern for notes and the workspaceAction pattern for actions; no new workspace package dependency (validators already a dependency of core and web).
